option_relations.rationale: SDHB-related paraganglioma is a specific type of succinate dehydrogenase (SDH)-deficient paraganglioma. The option also describes the location and recurrence, which are specific manifestations of the disease.
Hereditary paraganglioma–pheochromocytoma syndrome (SDHB mutation) is the underlying genetic syndrome that causes SDHB-related paraganglioma. The leaf is a manifestation of this syndrome.
Malignant paraganglioma (metastatic or multifocal) describes a characteristic of the paraganglioma, which can be SDHB-related. The leaf is a specific type of paraganglioma that can be malignant.
The option 'Paraganglioma (SDHB-related)' is clinically equivalent to the leaf 'SDHB-related paraganglioma'.
